channel.title: Divya Patel – Writing
channel.description: Writing by Divya Patel, Backend & Cloud Engineer: practical guides on system design, AWS, Terraform, caching with Redis, CI/CD and self-hosted LLM infrastructure, with diagrams.

item.title: Zero-downtime Lambda deploys from GitHub Actions: OIDC, versions, aliases and canary rollback
item.description: Deploy AWS Lambda from GitHub Actions with no stored AWS keys: OIDC login, versions, a weighted alias canary and automatic rollback.

item.title: Cache-aside, write-through and stampede protection: Redis in front of Aurora PostgreSQL
item.description: Redis caching patterns for Postgres in plain words: cache-aside vs write-through, cache stampede prevention, TTL jitter and safe invalidation.

item.title: Self-hosting an LLM with vLLM: the real cost math vs an API
item.description: A neutral break-even model for self-hosting an LLM with vLLM vs paying an API per token, with a worked example, real prices and a small production setup.

item.title: Terraform for a one-AWS-account startup: layout, state, and the day you split
item.description: How to structure Terraform for a small AWS startup: one state, then split state per stack and environment, then multi-account. With real HCL.
